title: Very thin metal
text: Very thin metal. Looks great with my tree.  The metal is very thin....i can see the brackets breaking when removing it after Christmas.  Guess it was a good deal for a reason.

product_metadata.title: FUNPENY Metal Christmas Tree Collar, Christmas Tree Ring (21 inch Diameter Base) Durable Galvanized Printed with Santa Pattern, Silver Christmas Metal Tree Skirt for Christmas Tree Decoration
features: Metal Galvanized Tree Collar: FUNPENY Christmas tree collar is printed with santa claus, reindeer, snowflake, and the silver finish adds the punchline to any Christmas tree, it will impressing your visitors. Compare with traditional tree skirt, our tree collar flares out slightly toward the base, is easily and use less area.

Easy to Install & Storage: Package include 4 peice of the tree collar, 8 sets of screws and nuts. No tool need, very easy and convenient to use. After Christmas is over, you can easily take it apart and store it in a box for next year's holiday.

Premium Quality: Made of high quality sturdy galvanized metal, is rust-proof reusable and made to last. Connect the 4 pcs metal panels for decorate a large Christmas tree, by removing one piece of panel for decorate a smaller tree.

Dimensions: The Christmas tree ring top diameter is 16.5 inch, bottom diameter is 20.8 inch, height is 9.05 inch. The exquisite Christmas tree collar can hide the clunky metal stands of tree. Protect the tree base from pets and children.

Perfect Christmas Tree Decoration: The natural fusion of FUNPENY metal tree collar and Christmas tree will add a Christmas atmosphere to your entire room, is perfect for Christmas and holiday parties. The pretty rustic farmhouse style tree collar, keep more warm feeling to your home during this winter. Bring Christmas festival atmosphere to your home and enjoy new year with your family.
